# KAVORYN Fine Art Prints & Posters

> Contemporary art-print studio based in India. Archival 230 GSM museum-grade posters designed to start conversations, not match the sofa.

## About KAVORYN
KAVORYN is an independent contemporary art studio specializing in graphic, typographic, and architectural fine art prints. Every piece is printed on museum-grade 230 GSM acid-free archival matte or 260 GSM gallery lustre paper using fade-resistant pigment inks. Orders are dispatched across India in reinforced triangular tubes to prevent edge creases.

## Storefront & Collections
- [Storefront / Homepage](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/): Discover the First Edition collection of 12 original prints.
- [All Prints Catalog](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/shop): Complete catalog of contemporary fine art prints.
- [FORM Collection](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/collections/form): Exercises in balance, bold geometry, and electric negative space.
- [FRAME Collection](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/collections/frame): Cinematic visual moments captured between stillness and light.
- [TYPE Collection](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/collections/type): Typographic manifestos typeset for rooms with an opinion.
- [ELSEWHERE Collection](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/collections/elsewhere): Atmospheric gradients and palettes drawn from distant coastlines.
- [ORGANIC Collection](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/collections/organic): Earthy structures where brutalist lines meet biophilic growth.
- [Custom Prints Studio](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/customize): Bespoke custom typographic poster commissioning.
- [About the Studio](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/about): Studio manifesto, archival materials, and production standards.
- [Track Your Order](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/track-order): Real-time shipment and delivery status tracking.
- [Contact & Support](https://kavoryn-two.vercel.app/contact): Studio inquiries, WhatsApp assistance, and customer support.

## Product Formats & Pricing
- A4 (21.0 × 29.7 cm / 8.3 × 11.7 in): ₹149 (Matte) / ₹199 (Lustre)
- A3 (29.7 × 42.0 cm / 11.7 × 16.5 in): ₹249 (Matte) / ₹299 (Lustre)
- A2 (42.0 × 59.4 cm / 16.5 × 23.4 in): ₹399 (Matte) / ₹449 (Lustre)
- A1 (59.4 × 84.1 cm / 23.4 × 33.1 in): ₹699 (Matte) / ₹749 (Lustre)
- Free Pan-India shipping on orders above ₹499. Standard shipping: ₹79.
